findings.finding: Original 5-second enumerations sum only live/observed per-PID own user+system. A process born and fully exited between enumerations can be absent from every recorded identity set.
Installed psutil macOS cpu_times implementation returns children_user=children_system=0. Original sampler also never reads either field. Reaped short-child CPU is not accumulated through this path.

Source017 default 2-second SkillObservationMonitor invokes diagnostics.inspect; currentNativeRun invokes MacProcessIdentityReader.read, whose execFileSync starts the packaged identity helper. This is a real idle-capable short-process spawn chain, not proof of how many executions occurred in original003.

Source020 collectSkillObservations can avoid full inspect for absent session or unchanged/missing revision, but changed evidence/explicit inspect still reaches the same identity spawn. Agent-browser command/client/lifecycle checks add other command-related short processes; this audit does not claim all of them are idle.

Darwin SDK exposes proc_pid_rusage for a live or zombie target PID and child user/system counters from RUSAGE_INFO_V1 onward. Headers do not themselves prove counter units, live/zombie/wait timing, recursive rollup, or reparent behavior.

getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) in an external Python sampler describes that sampler's own terminated children, not the App. SDK wait4 documentation gives returned usage for the terminated child and all its children, useful as a future controlled-probe reference, not a reason to intercept Node's wait/reaping.

independentScopeAdjudication.observedIdentitySetStability: only validates identities actually seen; does not exclude entirely unobserved short processes
independentScopeAdjudication.originalCompleteIdleCoverageAssertion: retain original S03 pass as historical analyzer output; its full-lifetime wording is not supported for entirely unseen child lifetimes
independentScopeAdjudication.originalFullOwnedProcessAssertion: S05 proves recorded seeds/metrics/Helper inclusion at sample time, not all between-sample lifetimes
independentScopeAdjudication.reason: The measured owned own-CPU contribution alone exceeds 5%; omitted nonnegative CPU cannot turn that failure into a pass. Preserve original activity partition, curves and all idle peaks.
independentScopeAdjudication.attributionBoundary: The original main-process share is a share of measured own CPU, not a proven share of full lifetime CPU including unseen children.
independentScopeAdjudication.futureObservedBelow5: insufficient for full-scope pass until missing child accounting and any ownership/reparent gaps are resolved and independently judged
